ne14afd68d9.headline: ECOnnect to supply FLNG terminal for Bahamas project
ne14afd68d9.summary: ECOnnect Energy agreed to supply a floating LNG import terminal to New Providence Gas for a project in the Bahamas.
ne14afd68d9.why: Floating LNG import terminals allow countries without gas pipelines to import liquefied natural gas, shaping regional energy supply options.

nd055891260.headline: Bulgaria and the euro: Dual price display ends on August 8 2026
nd055891260.summary: The one-year mandatory dual display of prices in leva and euro in Bulgaria ends on August 8 2026, according to the government's official website.
nd055891260.why: Bulgaria adopted the euro, and the end of dual pricing marks a step in the currency changeover affecting consumers and businesses.

n97800ab1d3.headline: Iran Faces Another Winter Energy Crisis as Billions of Dollars in Natural Gas Go Up in Flames
n97800ab1d3.summary: Iran faces another winter gas shortage while billions of dollars' worth of natural gas are lost each year through flaring. The situation reflects years of underinvestment and mismanagement.
n97800ab1d3.why: Iran holds some of the world's largest natural gas reserves, so domestic supply management affects regional gas markets and investment.

n4d4d9a38f6.headline: China steps up hunt for unpaid overseas taxes among wealthy citizens
n4d4d9a38f6.summary: Chinese officials are focusing on gains from property, equities, precious metals and cryptocurrencies held overseas by wealthy citizens. The effort aims at unpaid taxes.
n4d4d9a38f6.why: Tax enforcement on offshore wealth affects capital flows and asset-holding behavior among China's high-net-worth individuals.

n8b05b808ba.headline: Watch: Smoke engulfs Russian city after Ukraine targets two oil refineries in long-range attacks
n8b05b808ba.summary: A major refinery in Russia's Yaroslavl region caught fire after a drone attack. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy claimed Kyiv struck two oil-processing facilities deep inside Russia.
n8b05b808ba.why: Refinery outages reduce Russian fuel output and can affect product exports and global diesel and gasoline markets.

n0079cbb5e1.headline: Prof Mkumbo, Dangote hold strategic talks to bolster the firm’s investment in Tanzania
n0079cbb5e1.summary: Tanzanian minister Kitila Mkumbo leads a delegation to Lagos for talks with Aliko Dangote aimed at deepening investment cooperation. The meetings focus on Dangote's investment in Tanzania.
n0079cbb5e1.why: Dangote Group is one of Africa's largest conglomerates, with cement, refining and fertiliser operations across the continent.

nb2b30c39b0.headline: Centurion Accommodation Reit eyes sponsor pipeline for acquisitions as H1 results beat IPO forecast
nb2b30c39b0.summary: Centurion Accommodation Reit may look at development assets from sponsor Centurion Corporation, including the upcoming Kranji Close dormitory. Its first-half results beat its IPO forecast.
nb2b30c39b0.why: A REIT owns income-producing property and must distribute most of its income, so acquisitions from its sponsor affect future payouts and growth.

n751a37664f.headline: Poverty in Iran Deepens as Millions of Working Families Struggle to Survive
n751a37664f.summary: Poverty in Iran is expanding rapidly as inflation, declining purchasing power and structural economic problems leave millions of working families below the poverty line.
n751a37664f.why: Iran's economy is heavily exposed to inflation and sanctions-related pressures, which shape consumer demand, currency stability and the investment outlook for the country.

nbf6cc62313.headline: Mozambique: Regulatory Hurdles Continue to Hinder Operations of Dingsheng Minerals
nbf6cc62313.summary: Operational disruptions, regulatory hurdles and destruction of five core production lines continue to hinder Chinese-owned Dingsheng Minerals in Chibuto, Gaza province. The company mines heavy mineral sands.
nbf6cc62313.why: Heavy mineral sands such as titanium and zircon feed industrial supply chains, so disruptions at producers affect materials markets.

n9c2b9e8956.headline: Ukraine strikes back after Russian attacks claim yet more lives
n9c2b9e8956.summary: Ukraine struck oil facilities deep inside Russia in overnight attacks, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Thursday, as Kyiv stepped up efforts to weaken Russia's economy.
n9c2b9e8956.why: Attacks on Russian refineries and oil infrastructure can disrupt fuel output and export flows, affecting global crude and product prices.

na092ae4abe.headline: For every ₹1 spent on PM Modi's foreign visits since 2021, India received around ₹66,000 in FDI: Govt data shows - BusinessToday
na092ae4abe.summary: A parliamentary reply put the cost of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's foreign visits at about ₹500 crore for 2021-2025. Over April 2021 to December 2025, India recorded $381.8 billion in foreign direct investment.
na092ae4abe.why: Foreign direct investment is long-term capital that companies place in another country's factories, operations and assets, and it is a key indicator of an economy's attractiveness to investors.

n87e92d077c.headline: Cyprus industrial producer prices edge up in June
n87e92d077c.summary: Industrial producer prices in Cyprus rose 0.3 per cent in June, according to Eurostat, following a 3.2 per cent gain in May 2026.
n87e92d077c.why: Producer prices measure the cost pressures faced by manufacturers, and they often foreshadow changes in consumer inflation.

nef6ac82cd0.headline: Australian airline Jetstar will charge passengers to use the overhead lockers for their bags
nef6ac82cd0.summary: Australian airline Jetstar plans to charge passengers for using overhead compartments for their bags. The plan was reported without further details.
nef6ac82cd0.why: Jetstar is a low-cost Australian airline, and ancillary fees are a common way for budget carriers to raise revenue.

nbc8f896f33.headline: Daily output at Türkiye
nbc8f896f33.summary: Daily output at the Gabar oil field in southeastern Türkiye has reached a fresh record, a top official said. The field is in a region once associated with terrorism.
nbc8f896f33.why: Domestic oil production reduces Türkiye's reliance on imported crude, which affects its energy import bill and current account.

n77f55a3b36.headline: RBI Retains Tata Sons In Upper Layer NBFC List; De-registration Application Under Review
n77f55a3b36.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has retained Tata Sons on its Upper Layer NBFC list while its application to de-register as a Core Investment Company is examined. Several other major NBFCs also remain on the list.
n77f55a3b36.why: Tata Sons is the holding company of the Tata Group, and RBI classifications determine the regulatory requirements for large non-banking financial companies in India.

n65bc7c0eec.headline: Should NRIs split their savings between FCNR(B) and NRE Deposits? Here's how a mix can balance returns, currency risk - BusinessToday
n65bc7c0eec.summary: The RBI's temporary relaxation for NRI deposits has revived interest in FCNR(B) and NRE fixed deposits. The article suggests holding both may balance returns and currency risk.
n65bc7c0eec.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets rules for foreign-currency and non-resident deposits that flow into the Indian banking system. These deposits are a source of foreign-exchange inflows.

n490ebb4a0b.headline: Iran vows to target Gulf neighbors if US resumes strikes
n490ebb4a0b.summary: Iran has warned Gulf states it would target critical energy infrastructure across the region if the US launches another attack on its territory. The threat was reported by Daily Sabah.
n490ebb4a0b.why: Gulf states host major oil and gas production and export infrastructure, so threats to it directly affect global energy supply and prices.
n490ebb4a0b.why_moved: Iran's threat to target Gulf energy infrastructure if US strikes resume raises the risk of supply disruption.

n306fe8d36c.headline: Phillips 66 net profit rises 339% to $3.8bn in Q2 2026
n306fe8d36c.summary: Phillips 66 reported second-quarter 2026 net earnings of $3.8bn, up 339% from $877m in the same period a year earlier.
n306fe8d36c.why: Phillips 66 is a US refiner and midstream energy company, so its earnings reflect refining margins and fuel demand.

nfeb7e20a34.headline: Iran aims to ban U.S. and Israeli ships from Strait of Hormuz and charge others a toll
nfeb7e20a34.summary: Iran's parliament is reviewing a plan to ban ships linked to the US, Israel and other hostile countries from transiting the Strait of Hormuz and to charge others a toll. The Trump administration has rejected the plan.
nfeb7e20a34.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so any restriction on transit affects crude supply and freight costs.
nfeb7e20a34.why_moved: A proposed ban on ships linked to the US and Israel, plus tolls, raises the risk of disruption to a key oil transit route. The US has rejected the plan.

n9eb3a8f767.headline: Where will the most job losses occur in years to come? Here
n9eb3a8f767.summary: Nandan Nilekani says large corporations may shed more jobs due to automation, while small enterprises will create new employment. The comments concern India's labour market.
n9eb3a8f767.why: Automation and AI adoption affect employment patterns and corporate cost structures across the Indian economy.

nb39e48ab36.headline: 'It will end pretty soon': Trump hints at peace in US-Iran war; Tehran mocks 'theatre diplomacy'
nb39e48ab36.summary: Trump suggested the US-Iran war will end soon, while Tehran criticised the approach as theatre diplomacy and called for the US to fulfil its commitments.
nb39e48ab36.why: Signals about ending the US-Iran conflict affect expectations for oil supply and regional risk, which feed into global markets.

n28562c844b.headline: Former NZX chair James Miller appointed FMA chair
n28562c844b.summary: James Miller, former chair of the New Zealand Stock Exchange, has been appointed the new chair of the Financial Markets Authority.
n28562c844b.why: The Financial Markets Authority is New Zealand's financial markets regulator, and its chair oversees conduct and market oversight.

n842995c445.headline: Australian silicon company forced out of US by 40pc tariffs

n842995c445.why: Silicon is a key input for semiconductors and solar cells, and tariffs on imports of such materials affect producer export economics and supply chains.

nbbaf3c6c11.headline: Oil Prices Slip Below $80 Per Barrel As Iran-Oman Talks Raise Hopes Of US-Iran Deal
nbbaf3c6c11.summary: Oil prices declined below $80 a barrel as Iran-Oman talks raised hopes of a US-Iran peace deal that could ease Strait of Hormuz disruptions. Houthi attacks, threats to energy infrastructure and rising US crude inventories limited optimism.
nbbaf3c6c11.why: Brent is the main global crude benchmark, and disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, through which a large share of seaborne oil passes, strongly influence its price.
nbbaf3c6c11.why_moved: Progress in Iran-Oman negotiations on a potential US-Iran agreement raised hopes of easing Hormuz disruptions. Rising US crude inventories also limited upside.

nf34a80ffd6.headline: Yen struggles to keep intervention gains; US dollar near 6-week low on Iran deal concerns, payroll jitters
nf34a80ffd6.summary: The yen struggled to keep gains from intervention while the US dollar neared a six-week low on Iran deal concerns and payroll jitters.
nf34a80ffd6.why: The yen and dollar are major currency pairs, and their moves affect importers, exporters and global currency positioning.
nf34a80ffd6.why_moved: Concerns over an Iran deal and payroll data weighed on the dollar, while the yen gave back some intervention-driven gains.

nbbd8d872e7.headline: Singapore stocks rise on blue-chip gains; STI up 1%
nbbd8d872e7.summary: Singapore stocks rose with blue-chip gains, lifting the STI by 1%. Gainers outnumbered losers 239 to 338 across the broader market, with S$2.1 billion worth of securities traded.
nbbd8d872e7.why: The Straits Times Index tracks Singapore's largest listed companies and is a benchmark for Southeast Asian equities.

n48a25648bf.headline: Amid din, Lok Sabha passes taxation bill to promote domestic electronics manufacturing
n48a25648bf.summary: The Lok Sabha passed the Taxation and other Laws (Amendment) Bill on Thursday without debate amid opposition sloganeering. The bill is aimed at promoting domestic electronics manufacturing.
n48a25648bf.why: The Lok Sabha is India's lower house of parliament, and its tax legislation shapes incentives for manufacturers and investors in the economy.

nfcde5c65cf.headline: SGX records all-time highs in revenue, net profit for FY2026
nfcde5c65cf.summary: Singapore Exchange reported record revenue, up 13.9% to S$1.5 billion, and net profit up 7.8% to S$698.4 million for FY2026.
nfcde5c65cf.why: Singapore Exchange operates the city-state's stock and derivatives markets, so its results reflect trading activity across Asian markets.

n3c244316d0.headline: Rajya Sabha passes Appropriation No.3 Bill authorising Rs 54,067 crore excess spending for FY23
n3c244316d0.summary: The Rajya Sabha approved the Appropriation No.3 Bill, authorising excess spending of Rs 54,067 crore for the year ending March 31, 2023. A larger part covers debt repayment of Rs 53,871 crore.
n3c244316d0.why: Parliamentary appropriation bills authorise government spending beyond budgeted limits. They affect fiscal deficit tracking, which matters for India's sovereign debt investors.

n986a1e8910.headline: Fuel diplomacy sends Australia's trade surplus tanking
n986a1e8910.summary: Australia's goods trade surplus fell as imports of fuel and electric vehicles surged in response to the Middle East conflict. The article links the trade shift to the conflict.
n986a1e8910.why: The trade balance feeds into GDP and the Australian dollar, and shifts in fuel imports affect energy costs.

nc53e01989b.headline: Farm sector posts 2.9% growth in Q2
nc53e01989b.summary: The Philippines' agricultural output grew 2.9% in the second quarter, driven by crops, livestock, poultry and fisheries, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority.
nc53e01989b.why: The agriculture sector's output is a component of the Philippine GDP and affects food prices and rural incomes.

nd1bfbc3109.headline: Further rate tightening seen as inflation stays elevated
nd1bfbc3109.summary: Inflation is expected to stay elevated in coming months despite easing for a third straight month in July. Economists said this keeps pressure on the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas to raise rates further.
nd1bfbc3109.why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas sets the Philippines' policy rate, which influences borrowing costs, the peso and bank lending.

n9f1d158d95.headline: DeepSeek Doubles Down on Costly AI Infrastructure

n20f32ec938.summary: Nikkei and Kospi fell sharply, but analysts expect Indian stocks to hold ground and a consolidation phase to continue, according to BusinessLine.
